\hypertarget{offline-access-simulator}{%
\section{Offline access simulator}\label{offline-access-simulator}}

\texttt{akl\_simulate.py} evaluates \texttt{access\_expectations.yaml} against the model with the documented
semantics (wildcards \texttt{*} and \texttt{+}, implied \texttt{list}, deny precedence, sub-claim OR/AND/globs/case,
templated paths). Assumptions it makes - verify live once: \texttt{/a/*} does not match \texttt{/a} itself;
explicit \texttt{AND}/\texttt{OR} sub-claim operators are evaluated left to right.

\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere,frame=leftline,framerule=1.2pt,rulecolor=\color{wo-rule},xleftmargin=6pt]
python3 scripts/akl_simulate.py --model terraform/model --expectations terraform/model/access_expectations.yaml --explain
\end{Verbatim}

\hypertarget{live-verification}{%
\section{Live verification}\label{live-verification}}

Give personas a CLI \texttt{profile} (test SSO user in the right group, test workload identity) and run:

\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere,frame=leftline,framerule=1.2pt,rulecolor=\color{wo-rule},xleftmargin=6pt]
python3 scripts/akl_verify.py --expectations terraform/model/access_expectations.yaml
\end{Verbatim}

It calls \texttt{describe-permissions\ -\/-json} as each persona and compares \texttt{client\_permissions} with the
expected set. How the CLI reports "no access at all" is not documented: by default an error stops
the run; after checking the behaviour, \texttt{-\/-error-means-no-access} treats it as an empty set.

\hypertarget{running-everything-locally}{%
\section{Running everything locally}\label{running-everything-locally}}

One command: \texttt{scripts/watchover\ test} (or \texttt{-\/-tool\ tofu}). Step by step:

\begin{Verbatim}[fontsize=\footnotesize,breaklines,breakanywhere,frame=leftline,framerule=1.2pt,rulecolor=\color{wo-rule},xleftmargin=6pt]
(cd terraform && terraform init -backend=false && terraform validate && terraform test && tests/guard_messages.sh terraform)
(cd bootstrap && terraform init -backend=false && terraform test)
pip install pyyaml pytest && python3 -m pytest -q scripts/tests
python3 scripts/akl_simulate.py --model terraform/model --expectations terraform/model/access_expectations.yaml
\end{Verbatim}
